purpose: NCS MCP 품질·성능 개선 측정과 안전 경계

enforcement.commit_policy: Same-condition measured performance improvement AND no applicable quality/guardrail regression; unknown evidence never counts as pass.

threshold_policy.calibration: After two valid measurement cycles, version changes with rationale; never weaken existing safety rules.

scope.public: Check deployed enabled tools and identity before measurement.
scope.internal: K02-K05 and planner K06 require controlled eligible evaluation; do not infer production activation.

statistics.quality_interpretation: Fixed-fixture result; report uncertainty without claiming population guarantee.
statistics.timeouts: Retain in reliability denominator; never fabricate successful latency.
statistics.clustered_slot_metric: K03: scenario bootstrap; never Wilson over correlated 3*N slots

metrics.name: 독립 자연어 검색 Hit@3
metrics.scope: frozen HR holdout; all-major claims need separate stratified set
metrics.formula: count(expected unit code in top3)/all frozen queries; errors and unexpected empty responses remain misses

action.response: improve_search; retain all existing release gates

metrics.name: packet-backed 추천 Hit@1
metrics.formula: count(top1 unique source course ID + scope belongs to frozen gold)/all frozen answerable scenarios; errors and empty=miss

metrics.name: 상위 3개 직접근거 슬롯 비율
metrics.scope: frozen cases with >=3 preverified evidence-backed candidates
metrics.formula: count(slots with valid source IDs + same-scope task/KSA + training_goal_concept_text)/(3 * all frozen cases); missing/duplicate/error slots are zero

action.response: improve_direct_evidence; weak/cross-scope promotion checked by G03

metrics.name: 직접 KSA gap coverage@5
metrics.scope: frozen answerable cases with validated nonempty gap
metrics.formula: macro_mean(sum(frozen weights of unique gap IDs directly covered by same-scope top5 courses)/sum(all frozen gap weights)); exclude conflicting courses and token/implied/inherited-only links

metrics.name: 사람이 판단 가능한 교육계획 비율
metrics.formula: count(plans satisfying six guide checks, mandatory matrix/path/route, source chain, no explicit constraint conflict, human-review state, and human usability rubric)/all frozen plan requests

metrics.name: Warm MCP 응답 p95
metrics.scope: per surface/workload/cache_state/concurrency; MCP request to full structured response
metrics.formula: nearest_rank_p95(successful logical request elapsed_ms including retries); publish all-request errors/timeouts/completion alongside

action.response: hold_performance_acceptance; if interval crosses target use inconclusive

metrics.name: 통제된 cold initialize p95
metrics.scope: same release, verified independent fresh instance and snapshot cache miss
metrics.formula: nearest_rank_p95(first initialize request to valid initialize response); remote and local measured separately

metrics.name: 유효 요청 성공률·timeout 비율
metrics.scope: rolling 7 days per active surface and workload
metrics.formula: successes/all valid logical requests; timeouts/same denominator; expected valid clarification can succeed; 429/5xx/busy/unexpected errors fail

sample.deadlines: must be frozen and recorded before run
sample.retry_counting: one logical request; retain individual attempts

action.condition: Wilson95 upper success bound <0.995 OR lower timeout bound >0.005

metrics.name: 동일 DB 성능 회귀율
metrics.formula: candidate_latency/baseline_latency - 1, separately workload pooled p95 and every query p50

action.condition: reproduced in planned retest AND paired95 CI lower bound >0.05

metrics.name: 자격 API 결과 확인 완료율
metrics.scope: all competency units in one fixed DB; all majors
metrics.formula: (collected unit count + valid empty unit count)/all target units; exclude error

action.response: hold_qualification_evidence_readiness_only; plan guarded batches without executing from KPI

metrics.name: 소형 모델 도구 체이닝 통과율
metrics.scope: frozen chaining case file (one unit per major by fixed seed, ambiguous unit names excluded, two templates); public release-profile tools exactly as an MCP client receives them; one named local model
metrics.formula: passed cases / frozen cases; elements template passes when the final answer contains at least half of the element names, classification template when it contains the major and sub classification names

action.response: report false_no_data cases; no small-model compatibility claim while below the human-set target

comparison.method: paired cases on the same case file and model; exact McNemar two-sided alpha 0.05

supporting_outputs: false_no_data_rate (failed cases answering that the data does not exist / all cases)

added.reason: data that exists must not be reported as missing by weaker tool-calling models

guardrails.name: 원천 KSA 변경
guardrails.formula: Count changed/deleted (ksa_id,ksa_text_raw) mappings in the same source version; compare full row-hash manifests.
guardrails.on_violation: Hold affected transform/package promotion; compare preservation copy.

guardrails.name: 근거 없는 신뢰 승격·실질 정의 주장
guardrails.formula: Count claimed trusted rows without same-row human audit, packet/hash/reviewer/rationale/evidence/status provenance; separately count boilerplate/draft promoted or claimed substantive.
guardrails.on_violation: Exclude unproven rows from trusted KPI and send for reconfirmation; no automatic status mutation.

guardrails.name: source ID·범위·직접근거 위반
guardrails.formula: Count nonexistent source IDs, explicit scope violations, inherited-only or cross_scope_name_only promoted as core/direct evidence.
guardrails.on_violation: Withhold core-evidence status from affected recommendations.

guardrails.name: framework·legacy 근거 오염
guardrails.formula: Count guide samples used as source/scoring facts and SQF/study modules used as active default recommendation evidence.
guardrails.on_violation: Hold affected links/scoring and regenerate evidence.

guardrails.name: 활성 응답·증거 계약 결손
guardrails.formula: Count missing/mismatched mandatory response, route, guide, matrix and required nonempty static proof artifacts.
guardrails.on_violation: Hold affected surface readiness; distinguish disabled public facade from successful internal plan.

guardrails.name: 제약 적합성 허위 판정
guardrails.formula: Count explicit facility/method/level/time conflicts or unknown evidence represented as confirmed fit/executable.
guardrails.on_violation: Hold conflicting plan feasibility; unknown/not_requested alone remain review_required.

guardrails.name: 측정 타당성 위반
guardrails.formula: Count exposed/dev/self-retrieval as independent quality, dropped failures, name-only truth, comparison mismatch, or insufficient/missing evidence treated as pass.
guardrails.on_violation: Invalidate affected KPI judgment; preserve records and repair evaluation.

guardrails.name: guarded 실행 경계 위반
guardrails.formula: Count cooldown/retry/batch/preflight violations, overlapping broad writers, and no-save serving writes.
guardrails.on_violation: Stop affected collection/write wave and restore bounded single-writer conditions.

guardrails.name: Builder·배포 동일성 위반
guardrails.formula: Count operational refresh/package/deploy/baseline promotion outside versioned Builder or source/snapshot/deployment identity mismatch.
guardrails.on_violation: Hold production/baseline promotion; collection exceptions grant no deploy authority.

guardrails.name: 공식 판단 오인·비밀 노출
guardrails.formula: Count actual official approval/qualification/legal eligibility claims and actual secret exposure separately; missing approval flag is G05, not a proven false claim.
guardrails.on_violation: Block or correct affected public artifact; preserve safe audit evidence without exposing secret values.
